sloka: बभूव द्विगुणं वीर्यं बलं हर्षश्च संयुगे ।रामस्यास्त्रबलं चैव शत्रोर्निधनकाङ्क्षिणः ।। ६.१०५.२४ ।।
transliteration: babhūva dviguṇaṁ vīryaṁ balaṁ harṣaśca saṁyuge ।rāmasyāstrabalaṁ caiva śatrornidhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.105.24 ।।

translations.english: The strength, valiance, enthusiasm, and the strength of missiles of Rama, who was desirous of the destruction of the enemy, doubled.
